cover.caption: Vesle Aase sitter midt i veien og syr lapp på lapp og sting på sting.
cover.alt: Vesle Aase sitter midt i veien med en liten kjole med mange lapper i fanget. Rundt henne går gjessene og napper gress, og langt borte kommer en rytter.
cover.prompt: Vesle Aase sits cross-legged in the middle of the dusty road beside the Goose Meadow, sewing a small patched dress in her lap, and looks straight out at the viewer with a calm, knowing little smile. Nine geese, big and small, white and grey, waddle and nibble grass around her. Far away down the road, a tiny rider on a bay horse is coming. Soft spring light and dandelions everywhere.

Picture: Vesle Aase sits cross-legged in the middle of the dusty road beside the Goose Meadow, sewing a small patched dress in her lap, and looks straight out at the viewer with a calm, knowing little smile. Nine geese, big and small, white and grey, waddle and nibble grass around her. Far away down the road, a tiny rider on a bay horse is coming. Soft spring light and dandelions everywhere.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- Vesle Aase: A small, sturdy goose girl of about fifteen, a head shorter than most, with a round, sun-browned face, a small determined chin, a snub nose, calm dark-brown eyes that look straight at you and thick, straight eyebrows. Her thick dark-brown hair is in one short, stubby plait tied with red wool. She wears a plain brown wool dress mended with neat blue and green patches, a crisp white apron, wooden clogs and a little patchwork sewing bag hanging from her apron string.

Setting:
- the Goose Meadow: A wide, gently sloping green meadow full of golden dandelions and white dandelion clocks, with a dusty country road running along its lower edge between grassy ditches. A few young birches in bright new leaf and a low grey stone wall stand in the meadow, and in the background rises the king's big white timber castle with carved wooden balconies and blue window frames.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago. The king's castle is a big, white-painted timber palace with carved wooden balconies and blue window frames, set among green meadows beside a dusty country road with grassy ditches. The king has a large flock of geese, big and small, white and grey. Vesle Aase is always sewing a small dress made of patch on patch in many colours. The fine bedchamber has a tall door painted with blue and red rosemaling flowers and a worn wooden threshold, where the truth stone lies at night. The Prince rides a tall bay horse and wears a slim gold ring with a tiny red stone on his little finger, until the night he slips it onto a sleeping girl's finger.

This story's season, light and colours: Late spring in fresh, gentle pastels: bright-green meadows full of golden dandelions and fluffy white dandelion clocks, white and grey geese, a soft sky-blue sky and clear, milky morning light. The night scenes inside the castle are a deep, hushed blue, lit only by a single candle or the truth stone's warm golden glow.

characters.name: Vesle Aase
characters.description: En snill og rolig gåsepike som passer kongens gjess og tør å være ærlig, selv når andre prøver å skjule sannheten.
characters.look: A small, sturdy goose girl of about fifteen, a head shorter than most, with a round, sun-browned face, a small determined chin, a snub nose, calm dark-brown eyes that look straight at you and thick, straight eyebrows. Her thick dark-brown hair is in one short, stubby plait tied with red wool. She wears a plain brown wool dress mended with neat blue and green patches, a crisp white apron, wooden clogs and a little patchwork sewing bag hanging from her apron string.

characters.name: Vesle Aase som brud
characters.description: Vesle Aase på bryllupsdagen, i en ny kjole uten en eneste lapp og med ringen til kongssønnen på fingeren.
characters.look: A small, sturdy girl of about fifteen, a head shorter than most, with a round, sun-browned face, a small determined chin, a snub nose, calm dark-brown eyes and thick, straight eyebrows. Her thick dark-brown hair is pinned up under a small, glittering silver bridal crown with dangling spangles. She wears a new buttercup-yellow wedding dress without a single patch, embroidered with white daisies around the hem, soft white shoes and a slim gold ring with a tiny red stone on one finger.

characters.name: Kongssønnen fra England
characters.description: En høflig prins som leter etter den snilleste og mest ærlige han kan gifte seg med, og som velger å handle rolig når han blir skuffet.
characters.look: A tall, lean prince of about twenty-two with a long, kind face, a slightly long straight nose, calm hazel eyes, neat sandy hair parted at the side and a small, neatly trimmed sandy moustache. He wears a small gold crown, a bright scarlet riding coat with gold frogging across the chest, a white cravat, cream trousers and brown top boots with turned-down cuffs, and he has a polite, patient smile.

characters.name: Sannhetssteinen
characters.description: En liten blank stein som avslører om noen prøver å lure, og som hjelper prinsen å forstå hvem som er ærlig.
characters.look: A small, smooth, egg-shaped stone no bigger than a plum, polished so shiny that it gleams like a pearl: milky white with faint swirls of pale gold and rose inside. It has no face, but when it speaks or someone steps over it, it glows with a soft, warm golden light that spreads around it like candlelight. It lies quite still, looking wise and quietly magical.

characters.name: Den tredje prinsessa
characters.description: En vakker prinsesse som blir urolig for at sannheten skal komme fram, og derfor prøver å bytte plass med Aase om natta.
characters.look: A tall, willowy princess of about eighteen with a long neck, a narrow face, high arched brows over big, anxious dark-brown eyes, a delicate little mouth and glossy chocolate-brown hair in long, bouncy ringlets tied back with a pearl-studded ribbon. She wears a small pearl tiara, pearl earrings and a long peacock-blue gown with puffed sleeves and a lace collar, and carries a large white feather fan that she likes to hide behind.

illustrations.anchor: Da kom det en prins ridende.
illustrations.caption: Kongssønnen må stoppe hesten, for vesle Aase flytter seg ikke.
illustrations.alt: Vesle Aase sitter midt i veien og syr på en liten kjole med mange lapper. Rundt henne napper gjessene gress. Kongssønnen har stoppet hesten sin rett foran henne.

illustrations.caption: I tre dager ser kongssønnen på bilder av prinsesser. Så peker han: «Henne!»
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen sitter i en stor stol i en sal full av malte bilder av prinsesser. Han er trøtt, men peker bestemt på ett av bildene.
illustrations.prompt: In a sunny castle hall, fourteen painted portraits of different princesses in golden frames stand propped on easels and chairs and lean against the walls. The Prince slumps in a big armchair with tired, heavy eyes after three days of looking, and points firmly at one portrait: a plump princess with pale-blonde hair piled up high with a big bow on top, in a frilly peach-pink gown. On a little table beside him, a candle has burned right down to a stub.

illustrations.caption: «Ei som er ærlig tvers igjennom!» sier sannhetssteinen.
illustrations.alt: I en mørk gang lister vesle Aase seg inn på rommet og går over den lille steinen, som lyser gyllent. Kongssønnen står i skyggen og hører etter.
illustrations.prompt: Night in the dark castle corridor. Vesle Aase tiptoes in her stockings through the painted door of the fine bedchamber, carrying her clogs in one hand, and steps right over the Truth Stone on the worn threshold. The stone glows warm gold, lighting up her feet and the door frame. A few steps away in the shadows stands the Prince, listening with a pleased smile. Only the stone's glow and a little blue moonlight from a small window light the scene.

illustrations.alt: To tjenere bærer en stor koffert ut til vogna. Kongssønnen bukker høflig på trappa, og prinsessa skynder seg etter med røde kinn.
